description: This PHP source file defines a class that extends an existing DataSelector class to filter out zero values from a dataset, specifically filtering out zero Y-values to prevent markers from being displayed for those points.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector_NoZeros
classes.description: A class that filters out zero Y-values from data for the purpose of graphical display, extending the base DataSelector class.

methods.name: _select
methods.description: Determines if a given set of values should be marked (i.e., displayed), returning false if the Y-value is zero, true otherwise.
